questions.q: What is the tilt of Earth's axis?
questions.why: The script states the tilt is about twenty-three and a half degrees.

questions.q: What happens when your half of Earth leans toward the Sun?
options: Days are shorter and sunlight spreads out
Sunlight hits more directly and days are longer
questions.why: Leaning toward the Sun means direct sunlight and longer days, which is summer.

questions.q: About how long does each season last?
questions.why: A full year of 12 months divided into four seasons gives about 3 months each.
